# Game API

The game API lists the functions, structs and patch sites of F1 25 that [native plugins](/modding/native-plugins) can use. Each subsystem has its own header and its own page.

Bindings are found by signature at load time. The RVAs on each page are for this build.

## Opaque types

These types are known by name only. Use them through pointers.

`EntrantRecord`, `EntrantSetupMode`, `EntrantsManager`, `FEHomeViewModel`, `GdbTableCursor`, `NeAllocator`, `NeAllocatorVtbl`, `NeStr`
